cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Make the Test Test You
cards.instruction: Create a commitment test that gradually exposes what you are unwilling to risk yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Give up your prize seat to prove you're on my side.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will you give up yours too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Mine is essential for maintaining perspective.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I may have designed a test I wasn't planning to take.

mechanism: A tests its former event pupil commitment by demanding lost seat comfort, then treats its own seat as a teacher entitlement when B asks for equal sacrifice.
confusable: Not an honestly shared volunteer request: the test progressively reveals A refuses the same cost.
comparison: Sleep protected through leadership claims versus comfortable spectator position protected through past tuition.
seedUse: D227 prize seat/give yours/perspective/comfort/own test; S05 event supervision.
